question: In what form and location did Mahalakshmi manifest?
premises: Mahalakshmi is the subject of the manifestation.
The manifestation occurred on the Shrishaila mountain.
inference: Mahalakshmi manifested as a bilva tree on the Shrishaila mountain.
plain_english: Mahalakshmi was born as a bilva tree on the Shrishaila mountain.
